source: The owner's words typed in the same working session as reviews/OWNER_BOOK_POLISH_2026-11-24.json, in the desktop app, after the session reported the DM's working spread (pull request 98) and asked whether to merge and deploy. This record is written by the same session: it saw the words below typed.
whatThePlanIs: The steps shown to him on the private page «Второй проход книги» (https://claude.ai/artifact/7i7fSfLqy8kCsHqihKUBAL, version 2, section «План по шагам»), after the two already done: «Бой — раскладная карта», «Герои и „За столом“ по задачам», «Экран стола», «Полка», «Телефон игрока», and the paragraph «Материалы» (new book details for three campaigns first, then a look, then the rest). In the repository: docs/BOOK_SECOND_PASS_PLAN.md.

authorized: Stage 1160: the fight as one fold-out — the field and the DM's actions together.
Stage 1170: the Party's and the Table's pages by tasks — rest and experience beside the party's health, the evening apart from the campaign's settings, rare tools in an appendix.
Stage 1180: the table's screen — the book across the whole television, the battlefield at full height.
Stage 1190: the shelf — labelled shelves, «Продолжить» at the current book, no eight screens of scrolling.
Stage 1200: a player's phone — the hero and the die first, a thin head.
Stage 1210: new book materials for three campaigns, by Codex CLI, as the plan says: three first, then his look.
whatTheSessionTookFromIt.notAnswered: The session's question whether to merge and deploy pull requests 97 and 98 was not answered: nothing is merged or deployed.
notAuthorized: New book materials for the other campaigns: the plan itself puts his look at three campaigns before them.
Opening the two built-in adventures' written books (they wait for his reading, ADR 0074 §2.8).

howTheWorkIsDone: Each stage on its own branch and pull request, stacked on the one before (pull request 98 first); a work order, a section of ADR 0075 and a completion report each; the usual checks and journeys; a report to the owner at the end. Every phrase the session writes for the interface is listed for him to read; pictures are made by Codex CLI.
standingOwnerRulesThisWorkKeeps: 2026-11-19: the product «looks like an Excel table»; the next step obvious, not a search line.
2026-11-20: no rails — «DnD — это про свободу выбора и действий».
2026-11-21: sections full screen with a way to close, everything at hand, the least scrolling; every main DM task has a visible entry named with his own word.
2026-11-21: «Читать всё самому» — every phrase a model wrote is read by the owner before it reaches a table.
2026-11-23: each book has its own style from its campaign's art; book materials by Codex CLI.
unchangedBoundaries: The World Engine alone changes the world; rules and legality stay the server's.
Knowledge isolation: a player's client and the table's screen receive only their own projections.
No AI at the table; no paid provider call beyond the pictures Codex CLI makes for the book materials.
Nothing is merged or deployed by the session without the owner's word.
